machines.name: Shadow CI impact prediction and broad fallback
machines.explicitness: implicit execution lifecycle plus explicit evidence/verdict labels
machines.state_storage: Validated impact map/immutable host descriptors, changed-path inputs, JSON receipt and appended summary

transitions.event: load map and canonical host descriptors
transitions.guard: known schema/lanes/scopes, unique check IDs and edge identities, nonempty edges and broad-lane declaration; only canonical core/hosts.json
transitions.effects: Construct immutable descriptors and mapping objects.
transitions.failure_retry: Invalid map or descriptor load returns a broad fallback through CLI handling, not reduced coverage.

transitions.guard: all relative POSIX paths match explicit or descriptor-derived edges with known host checks
transitions.effects: Deduplicate selected checks; report predicted_not_selected and matched paths.
transitions.failure_retry: Descriptor rules use first matching rule and exact excludes; unknown path/host mapping cannot silently suppress checks.

transitions.event: empty, invalid or unmapped changed path
transitions.guard: at least one path cannot be classified
transitions.effects: Select broad-lane only and leave predicted_not_selected empty.
transitions.failure_retry: Never infer irrelevance under fallback.

transitions.guard: caught ImpactMapError/OSError/ValueError
transitions.effects: Create built-in broad validation check and include error reason.
transitions.failure_retry: Receipt filesystem write failure can still propagate; successful planner exit is not proof a job ran.

transitions.guard: output and summary paths writable
transitions.effects: Overwrite requested JSON output and append Markdown summary; return zero.
transitions.failure_retry: Shadow-mode planner does not change current job if conditions or skip any existing CI job.

machines.notes: This is an existing example of the recommended shadow rollout: explicit predicted decisions and conservative unknown behavior without changing production admission.

machines.name: Native statement coverage collection, publication and union verdict

machines.state_storage: Exact module/source hashes, native platform/toolchain, new output directory, unit/integration profiles and final metadata

transitions.guard: supported native Go host equals target; expected platform agrees; output outside module and absent
transitions.effects: Hash every module input excluding .git; discover packages; create output directory and run offline atomic-coverage unit command.
transitions.failure_retry: Linked/oversized input, cross target or existing output rejects.

transitions.guard: nonzero/timeout before complete profile validation
transitions.effects: Keep available unit log and partial owned output for diagnosis.
transitions.failure_retry: No metadata.json is published; retry requires a fresh output directory.

transitions.event: validate unit and optional integration profiles
transitions.guard: atomic mode, exact production-source bounds, profile/sidecar hashes and native source/toolchain identity; no source drift
transitions.effects: Copy valid integration profiles and write exclusive metadata.json last.
transitions.failure_retry: Malformed/foreign/stale profile or changed module fails without usable metadata.

transitions.guard: pre-build source identity equals current; native platform/toolchain and valid profile
transitions.effects: Return source/platform/version/profile hash sidecar for producer to write.
transitions.failure_retry: Unkeyed hashes detect inconsistency, not forged execution; caller owns real binary exercise.

transitions.guard: unique expected supported platforms; all source/toolchain/package/command identities exact; hashes and shared instrumentation layouts agree
transitions.effects: Union covered statement blocks from unit and integration profiles.
transitions.failure_retry: Duplicate/foreign/stale input, conflicting statement counts or changed source => INVALID.

transitions.guard: seen platform set incomplete
transitions.effects: Report exact present/missing platforms and statements; CLI nonzero.
transitions.failure_retry: No absent host counted as zero-cost verified work.

transitions.guard: platform population complete but an executable package lacks a covered integration block
transitions.effects: Report missing integration platforms; CLI nonzero.
transitions.failure_retry: Unit coverage alone cannot fulfill require-integration.

transitions.guard: all required populations complete; covered statements below caller-specified finite minimum
transitions.effects: Report numeric result and threshold; CLI nonzero.
transitions.failure_retry: No built-in policy threshold; the workflow supplies 70 percent.

transitions.guard: no missing platform/integration; minimum absent or met
transitions.effects: Report statement totals/coverage and explicit not_measured=[lines,branches]; CLI zero.
transitions.failure_retry: This metric report is not itself a native qualification receipt.

machines.name: Go test population discovery, chunk execution and exact-result accounting
machines.explicitness: implicit execution lifecycle plus explicit evidence/verdict labels
machines.state_storage: Compiled temporary test binaries, actual listed Test/Example/Fuzz names, weighted chunks and terminal result map

transitions.guard: jobs 1..64; valid duration/hints; Go package enumeration succeeds
transitions.effects: Compile every package with test files once into temporary binary directory; 1800-second build bound.
transitions.failure_retry: Invalid hints, package enumeration/compile failure or missing expected binary fails.

transitions.guard: each binary lists actual Test/Example/Fuzz targets within 600-second bound
transitions.effects: Build exact-name chunks; timing hints only order/balance, never remove membership.
transitions.failure_retry: Listing failure rejects; unsupported duration is invalid.

transitions.guard: up to declared workers; exact anchored target pattern
transitions.effects: Run direct child binary once with Go test timeout plus 120-second outer margin; convert captured stream with test2json.
transitions.failure_retry: Outer timeout terminates direct child, preserves partial output and marks code=-1.

transitions.guard: event is pass/fail/skip; no subtest slash
transitions.effects: Store result; repeated terminal event for same test becomes repeated.
transitions.failure_retry: Unknown/stray target or failed/repeated/missing selected outcome rejects chunk.

transitions.guard: each expected target observed; every chunk exit zero; outcomes pass or skip; no stray events
transitions.effects: Report counts of passed and skipped targets and exit zero.
transitions.failure_retry: Skips are deliberately permitted; group complete is not a claim every listed target ran substantively.

transitions.event: any failed/stray/missing result or process failure
transitions.guard: acceptance predicate fails
transitions.effects: Print bounded failure output and missing-result list; exit one; remove temporary binaries.
transitions.failure_retry: Rerun after cause corrected; no reuse of prior partial success as full result.

findings.title: Statusline benchmark comparison can print PASS for zero measurements
findings.claim: cmd_compare iterates base.scenarios and accepts an empty object with no failures. cmd_run can naturally produce that empty object when every --scenario value is unknown, because it filters without validating the requested names.
findings.probe: audit-work/probe_tool_verdicts.json: empty base/head scenarios -> exit 0 and PASS text; no renderer ran.
findings.recommendation: Require a nonempty declared scenario population and compatible harness/measurement identity before any success verdict. Keep explicitly selected subsets visible rather than claiming full benchmark coverage.

findings.status: pure local oracle probe reproduced; subprocess-result issue source-confirmed
findings.title: Live SMARTS exercise tests literal lens-name presence rather than its stated material-comparison contract
findings.claim: The material judge accepts any three lens-name substrings in SEC-SMARTS. One paragraph containing Scalable Maintainable Available passed with no alternatives or table. main records judge output regardless of Claude return code, so a failed session can still produce PASS if its remaining spec satisfies this weak shape.
findings.probe: audit-work/probe_tool_verdicts.json: three lens names, one paragraph, table=false -> judge=true; no provider call ran.
findings.recommendation: Gate process completion separately from artifact validity, and validate explicit material alternatives/comparison semantics through native schema/contract checks plus bounded reviewed qualitative evidence. Do not equate substring count with a comparison.

findings.status: source-confirmed; no live baseline mismatch asserted
findings.title: CI20 evidence binds HEAD and current workflow hash without ensuring workflow bytes belong to that HEAD
findings.claim: collect checks run.head_sha == checkout HEAD, then parses the working-tree workflow. Neither baseline nor inventory requires clean tracked bytes or equality to git show HEAD:.github/workflows/ci.yml. A modified checkout can therefore label its analysis with a matching source commit while analyzing different workflow bytes.
findings.recommendation: Read workflow bytes from the bound commit or require exact blob equality before mapping jobs/commands. Preserve the observed file hash, run identity and counterfactual-vs-live distinction.

findings.title: Statusline illustration can proceed after failed renders and leaves some temporary inputs behind
findings.claim: Both statusline subprocess results are accepted without return-code/stderr validation. Normal cleanup omits earlier.jsonl and only removes legacy ledger.json, so the final directory removal can fail and is ignored. No screenshot corruption was reproduced in this audit.
findings.recommendation: Require successful nonempty render output before screenshotting, wrap all temporary state/browser lifetime in cleanup, and retain the image’s explicit mock-data provenance.

read_but_not_separate_machines.classification: Strict canonical registry loader and deep immutable projection, no additional durable transition lifecycle. Root-contract exceptions for Claude/Codex/Pi, permission action mapping, unique names/roots and valid condition tags are fully read.

Read-only report projection of farm terminal states; settled/green/escalated/blocked/first-vs-multi-attempt rates. Missing file fails. No worker dispatch or premium re-dispatch side effect in this script.

Read-only historical finding-table projection. Not-run excluded from dispatch denominator, PASS zero findings counts, auth alias normalized, unreadable documents warn/skip. It measures persisted checkpoints, not all actual dispatches.

coverage.validation: Two pure local decision probes only. No model session, GitHub read, native Go test, image/browser run, package publication or user workspace modification. Generated reports/probes are scratch audit artifacts.

decision: Treat evidence completeness and process success as separate typed predicates before a pass or promotion claim. Reuse existing explicit good patterns (coverage population/identity gates, Tribunal separate verified recall and synthetic ineligibility, impact shadow fallback) while preserving current product contracts.
